title: Rethinking Normalization Placement for LLMs: Post-Norm under Curriculum Depth Growing
abstract: arXiv:2608.13156v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pre-norm is the standard normalization placement in modern Transformers because it facilitates joint optimization of full-depth models. We ask whether this preference persists when depth is introduced through a curriculum. In curriculum depth growth, each appended block receives the boundary representation produced by a trained prefix, making normalization placement relevant to forward conditioning. We therefore test whether placement and training curriculum interact. In a controlled distillation study with a Qwen3-8B teacher and a nine-layer student, pre-norm and post-norm are indistinguishable under joint training, differing by $0.0004$ validation CE, while post-norm improves over pre-norm by $0.0328$ under curriculum growth, an order of magnitude larger. translated_title: 重新思考大型语言模型中的归一化位置：课程深度增长下的后归一化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13156v1 公告类型：新 摘要：预归一化是现代Transformer中的标准归一化位置，因为它有助于全深度模型的联合优化。我们质疑当通过课程方式引入深度时，这种偏好是否仍然存在。在课程深度增长中，每个附加块接收由训练好的前缀产生的边界表示，这使得归一化位置与前向条件化相关。因此，我们测试位置和训练课程是否相互作用。在一项受控蒸馏研究中，使用Qwen3-8B教师和九层学生，预归一化和后归一化在联合训练下无法区分，验证交叉熵差异为0.0004，而在课程增长下，后归一化比预归一化提高了0.0328，高出一个数量级。一个由学生活动层令牌匹配的后联合控制仍比后增长差，这排除了计算量作为唯一解释。排名在课程期间发生交叉。
tldr: 本文发现，在课程深度增长训练中，后归一化相比预归一化显著提升性能，而联合训练下两者无差异，表明归一化位置与训练课程存在交互作用。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that post-norm significantly outperforms pre-norm under curriculum depth growth, while they are indistinguishable under joint training, revealing an interaction between normalization placement and training curriculum.
